host: AMD EPYC9354, CPU31 pinned, one thread, first-touch local allocation. Its CCD L3 is32MiB; streaming replicas use128–142MiB. No8-thread result, DMA or edge calibration.
scope: Nominal rowwise-W8 metadata and opaque4B result gathering; actual checkpoints are not converted or numerically evaluated. Native rawI32 output/scaling contract remains unverified.
metadata_contract: A single FP32 scale per logical output row is an explicit W8 format choice. It does not describe arbitrary GGUF Q8_0/Q4, NVFP4/FP8 blockwise metadata or a published AiF PE scale interface.

The host can retain dense row-scale vectors in ordinary DRAM and keep their logical row order while coefficient rows move. This uses existing software memory; its residency cost is reported rather than treated as free or added to MAC coefficient pages.

Scales are needed once per useful row if host dequantization applies them; primary opaqueF32 memcpy does not read scales. If the native opaque result already includes scale, the logical scales may be retained for model metadata without a per-token host read.

Two handles per expert assume gate/up vertically fused plus down. Handle indices can be implicit;8B handle and32B band entry tables are explicit uncompressed sizing examples, not mandatory lower bounds or an AiF command ABI. Existing FTL mappings/profile labels may compress or subsume them.

No per-row pointer table is necessary: original row_start plus dense scale/output base selects rows. The benchmark gather descriptor is exactly16B; native flash address and geometry are a separate assumed32B entry.

If metadata remains in flash, ordinary read work must be paid independently. Q38 per-projection page-aligned selected scale fetch is1056 pages=17,301,504B/token versus8,110,080B useful scales. Dense packing can reduce amplification but requires a real placement/fetch schedule; no free read or latency estimate is claimed.

DeepLite uses26 MoE layers and one merged sharedI2816 FFN per layer; one initial denseI10944 layer adds95,744B scales and same4B outputs separately. G4sharedI1024 appears in all40layers; Q38sharedI640 in48base layers, auxiliaryMTP excluded.
gather_contract: Native outputs are represented by known4B words in16 separately64B-aligned chip staging buffers. Source space includes every complete output row in requested16KiB coefficient pages; only useful row bands are gathered into contiguous logical expert/projection outputs.

Q38 uses actual saved first-route item lists for all48layers in three frozen families. group_g16 means routed equal16; its shared FFN remains the original fitted shared control and may use fewer than16 chips, explaining16,752 total bands versus generic equal16 ledger16,896.

G4 uses all40frozen row allocations and existing training request0/step0 routes. Sealed G4 study originally excluded shared; a verified-shape equal16shared geometry is appended identically to every benchmark case, not claimed to be the old study shared placement.

Every destination scalar is checked bitwise before/after timing; source fringe is poisoned and excluded. C++ validates exact nonoverlapping coverage. Source words are synthetic known values, not actual model outputs or native numerical validation.

The operation traverses a full-token list of per-layer/per-phase row-band copies serially. The full-token staged working set is a benchmark choice, not a requirement to retain all layers live. Actual runtime could reuse smaller per-layer buffers.

Primary copy-only operation changes no values or column association. Conditional I32 convert/multiply uses small exact test integers and synthetic power-of-two row scales; it is a simple reference loop, not optimized/vendor kernel or verified native capability.
Conditional rescale stages only selected logical scale vectors; it does not benchmark arbitrary cache misses against the full360.7MiB model-scale table. Full resident memory is separately ledgered.
A documented direct DMA/scatter-to-logical-row-offset interface could remove host copy. Since that backend interface is unverified, this is an optional fallback cost, not a mandatory hardware tax.

The conditional one-multiply rescale probe uses input activation scale=1, or assumes the supplied row-factor vector is already combined. Forming factors for arbitrary per-expert activation scales, route alpha, biases or quantization is outside this probe and may add work; do not call it complete W8A8 inference cost.

benchmark_design.timing: std::chrono::steady_clock per full-token copy pass; initialization and checksum outside timed section
benchmark_design.repetitions: One bounded campaign, no performance-based reruns or dropped outliers.

interpretation: The measured EPYC opaque copy distributions are much smaller than7.819ms even if charged wholly to the new whole-row family. Both matched families need the same useful8,110,080B output payload, so common memory-copy/scaling work is not a new-only penalty.

Whole versus overlap has2880 additional bands. A distinct, unmodeled incremental host cost ofabout2.715us for each extra band could erase the conditional gap. It must be separate from the controller command duration already varied; do not double-count that dispatch cost.

If only whole-row needed copying and overlap had a proven zero-copy path, an effective payload copy rate at or belowabout1.04GB/s could consume the gap. No such asymmetric API is established; edge hosts are unmeasured.

No per-completion callback/syscall, host activation, native-to-host DMA, kernel wakeup, queue/synchronization or CPU/NAND overlap is measured here. Any of these could alter total runtime. EPYC server timing cannot calibrate a phone/edge host.

Separate-run median differences are not attributed to placement. In conditional old-overlap rescale streaming,p99=8.196ms outlier is retained; cause was not measured. Copy-only whole streamingp99=1.243ms. These descriptive tails are not probability guarantees.
